title: What’s New at GoLinks: October 2025
summary: Discover GoLinks product updates for October 2025. Explore new features like go links in Slack DMs, advanced LLMs, and new integrations.
body_text: At GoLinks, we’re always looking for ways to make your workday more seamless, connected, and productive. This month, we’re excited to roll out four major updates designed to help your team save time, collaborate more effectively, and get the most out of your tools. From smarter AI-powered search to clickable go links in private Slack conversations, plus two powerful new Microsoft integrations, these updates are built to meet you where you work. Let’s dive in. 1. Clickable Go Links in Slack DMs One of our most requested features is finally here: go links in Slack direct messages (DMs) now instantly convert into clickable redirects with previews. Previously, go links automatically expanded into clickable previews in Slack channels, but DMs remained plain text. That meant you had to copy and paste go links into a browser to use them in private conversations. Now, go links, multi-links, and Collections shared in Slack DMs work just like they do in channels, making private conversations just as productive as group discussions. Why it matters: Keep 1:1 or small group chats efficient by sharing instantly usable go links. Eliminate the extra step of copying and pasting links from Slack into your browser. Enjoy consistent go link functionality across Slack, whether in channels or private conversations. Getting started: Admins will need to update the GoLinks Slack integration to add this feature. Once updated, all team members can enable clickable go links in their own private chats. 2. Advanced LLM Options for GoAI We’re taking GoAI to the next level with new advanced large language model (LLM) options. You can now choose between GPT‑5, Claude Sonnet, and Haiku to power your search results and Slack bot answers. Why does this matter? Different LLMs bring unique strengths: GPT‑5 : Strong at fast, accurate summaries and general knowledge queries. Claude Sonnet : Excels at nuanced reasoning and detailed responses. Haiku : Delivers concise, to-the-point answers when brevity matters. This flexibility means you can tailor GoAI to fit your team’s workflows, whether you need quick answers, deep insights, or something in between. How it works: In your GoLinks dashboard, type a query like “new hire onboarding resources.” GoAI will summarize key information and provide relevant go links. In Slack, simply tag the GoLinks bot in a channel or use the /go command in a DM with the bot. GoAI will respond in real time with summaries and actionable links. By giving you control over the underlying LLM, we’re making GoAI more adaptable, reliable, and valuable to your unique needs. 3. GoLinks for Microsoft Word We know that teams spend countless hours drafting, editing, and collaborating in Microsoft Word. That’s why we’ve built a new integration to make Word documents more powerful with GoLinks. With the new GoLinks for Microsoft Word integration, any go links you drop into a document can be instantly converted into clickable links. Instead of long, messy URLs that disrupt the flow of your content, go links stay short, clean, and readable, while still providing instant access to the resources behind them. Benefits: Share docs with clear, branded go links instead of raw URLs. Keep links usable for readers without needing to copy and paste. Improve readability and maintain a polished, professional look in shared documents. This integration ensures that your knowledge flows seamlessly between documents and the web, making it easier for teams to find and act on the right resources. 4. GoLinks for Microsoft Outlook Email is still the backbone of workplace communication, and now your inbox just got an upgrade. With the new GoLinks for Microsoft Outlook integration, go links shared in emails are displayed as a clickable preview. No more digging through long, unrecognizable URLs in email threads. With go links, your communications are shorter, cleaner, and easier to understand, while still pointing to the same trusted resources. Benefits: Share go links in emails that expand into clickable links. Provide teammates with instant context and confidence about the resource you’re sharing. Make email threads more navigable and actionable. With Word and Outlook now fully integrated, GoLinks is embedded directly into the Microsoft tools your team uses every day. Why These Updates Matter Together, these four features unlock even more value from GoLinks: Consistency across platforms: Whether in Slack, Word, or Outlook, go links behave the same: clean, clickable, and easy to use. Smarter knowledge access: With advanced LLM options, GoAI adapts to your team’s needs, helping you search, summarize, and act faster. Streamlined collaboration: Clean, branded go links keep communication professional and efficient across documents, emails, and chat. At GoLinks, our goal is to remove friction from your workflows so you can focus on what matters most: building, collaborating, and moving work forward. Try It Out Today These features are available now. To get started: Update your Slack integration to enable clickable go links in DMs. Enable Microsoft Word and Outlook integrations from the GoLinks dashboard. Explore GoAI’s advanced LLM options in your dashboard settings. We can’t wait for you to try these new capabilities and see how much more productive your team can be with GoLinks. Not using GoLinks yet? Sign up for a free account instantly. Access and share resources instantly with GoLinks Try for free

title: Rekrutmen PLN 2025 Dibuka: Formasi, Persyaratan, & Cara Daftar
summary: Rekrutmen nasional PLN Group 2025 resmi dibuka sampai 5 Oktober! Simak formasi, syarat, tahapan, & tahapan pendaftarannya!
body_text: PT PLN (Persero) kembali membuka Rekrutmen Nasional 2025 yang berlangsung mulai 1–5 Oktober 2025 . Program ini menjadi langkah strategis perusahaan untuk memperkuat ketahanan energi nasional sekaligus mendukung transformasi menuju energi bersih dan digitalisasi kelistrikan. Direktur Utama PLN, Darmawan Prasodjo, menegaskan bahwa rekrutmen ini mengajak generasi muda berkontribusi dalam mewujudkan visi Indonesia Emas 2045 . Jika kamu tertarik mendaftar di salah satu instansi BUMN ini, simak jadwal, formasi, dan cara daftarnya dalam artikel berikut! Sebelum Lanjut, Siapa Tahu Kamu Butuh Ini: Lowongan Kerja Electrical Engineer Lowongan Kerja Mechanical Engineer Lowongan Kerja Civil Engineer Lowongan Kerja Finance & Accounting Formasi dan Jurusan yang Dibuka Rekrutmen tahun ini terbuka bagi lulusan D3, S1/D4, hingga S2 dari berbagai jurusan. Beberapa anak perusahaan PLN Group yang membuka formasi antara lain: 1. Minat Profesi Proyeksi PT PLN Indonesia Power Sebagai salah satu anak perusahaan PLN yang bergerak di bidang pembangkitan tenaga listrik, PT PLN Indonesia Power membuka kesempatan kerja untuk lulusan D3 dan S1/D4 di berbagai jurusan teknik, dengan penempatan di seluruh wilayah Indonesia . Formasi D3 Minimal IPK : 3,0 Jurusan : Teknik Elektro, Teknik Mesin, Teknik Sipil Formasi S1/D4 Minimal IPK : 3,0 Jurusan : Teknik Elektro, Teknik Mesin, Teknik Sipil, Energi Baru Terbarukan, Data Science, Keselamatan dan Kesehatan Kerja (K3), Konversi Energi, Safety Engineering, Teknik Geodesi, Teknik Industri, Teknik Informatika, Teknik Kimia, Teknik Lingkungan, dan Teknik Material 2. Minat Profesi Proyeksi PT PLN Electricity Services PT PLN Electricity Services (PLN ES) adalah penyedia solusi kelistrikan total mulai dari operasi & pemeliharaan (O&M), rekayasa, konstruksi, hingga layanan manajemen aset dan energi baru berbasis digital untuk mendukung infrastruktur kelistrikan nasional. Anak perusahaan PLN Group ini membuka kesempatan kerja bagi lulusan D3 dan S1/D4, dengan penempatan tersedia di seluruh wilayah Indonesia. Formasi D3 Minimal IPK : 3,0 Jurusan : Administrasi Bisnis, Keuangan, Teknik Elektro, Teknik Informatika Formasi S1/D4 Minimal IPK : 3,0 Jurusan : Administrasi Bisnis, Manajemen, Teknik Elektro 3. Minat Profesi Proyeksi PT PLN Nusantara Power PT PLN Nusantara Power merupakan anak perusahaan PLN yang bergerak di bidang pembangkitan listrik berbasis energi konvensional dan terbarukan. Pada Rekrutmen Nasional 2025, perusahaan ini membuka formasi untuk lulusan D3 dan S1/D4, dengan penempatan di seluruh wilayah Indonesia. Formasi D3 Minimal IPK : 3,0 Jurusan : Akuntansi Formasi S1/D4 Minimal IPK : 3,0 Jurusan : Teknik Elektro, Teknik Mesin, Teknik Industri, Teknik Lingkungan, Teknik Sipil, Akuntansi, Keselamatan dan Kesehatan Kerja (K3), Keuangan, Ilmu Lingkungan, Supply Chain Management, Logistik 4. Minat Profesi Proyeksi PLN Group – Bidang Hukum (S1) PLN Group juga membuka kesempatan bagi lulusan S1 dan S2 Hukum untuk bergabung melalui Rekrutmen Nasional 2025. Posisi ini terbuka untuk penempatan di seluruh wilayah Indonesia. Formasi S1 Minimal IPK : 3,0 Jurusan : Hukum Formasi S2 Minimal IPK: 3,0 Jurusan : Hukum, Public Policy 5. Minat Profesi Proyeksi PT PLN Energi Primer Indonesia PT PLN Energi Primer Indonesia adalah anak perusahaan PLN yang berfokus pada pengelolaan rantai pasok energi primer, seperti batu bara dan gas, untuk mendukung pembangkit listrik nasional. Dalam Rekrutmen Nasional 2025, perusahaan ini membuka formasi untuk lulusan S1/D4 dengan penempatan di seluruh Indonesia. Formasi S1/D4 Minimal IPK : 3,0 Jurusan : Supply Chain Management, Teknik Geologi, Teknik Industri, Teknik Pertambangan 6. Minat Profesi Proyeksi PLN Group – Bidang Matematika Selain jurusan teknik dan manajemen, PLN Group juga membuka formasi khusus bagi lulusan S1/D4 Matematika . Posisi ini tersedia untuk penempatan di seluruh wilayah Indonesia. Formasi S1/D4 Minimal IPK: 3,0 Jurusan: Matematika 7. Minat Profesi Proyeksi PT PLN Nusa Daya PT PLN Nusa Daya adalah anak perusahaan PLN yang bergerak di bidang jasa pengoperasian dan pemeliharaan pembangkit listrik. Pada Rekrutmen Nasional 2025, perusahaan ini membuka formasi untuk lulusan D3 serta S1/D4, dengan penempatan di seluruh Indonesia. Formasi D3 Minimal IPK : 3,0 Jurusan : Teknik Mesin, Teknik Listrik Formasi S1/D4 Minimal IPK : 3,0 Jurusan : Akuntansi, Komunikasi, Manajemen, Manajemen Bisnis, Manajemen Keuangan, Psikologi, Teknik Listrik, Teknik Mesin Timeline Rekrutmen PLN 2025 Proses pendaftaran Rekrutmen Nasional PLN 2025 berlangsung dalam waktu yang cukup singkat. Peserta disarankan menyiapkan dokumen sejak awal agar tidak melewati batas waktu yang ditentukan. Berikut jadwal utamanya: Pembukaan Pendaftaran: 1 Oktober 2025 Penutupan Pendaftaran: 5 Oktober 2025 (pukul 23.59 WIB) Karena masa pendaftaran hanya berlangsung selama 5 hari , kamu sebaiknya segera membuat akun, melengkapi data, dan mengunggah dokumen yang dipersyaratkan. Tahapan Rekrutmen PLN 2025 Jika kamu makin tertarik untuk mendaftar rekrutmen nasional PLN ini, kamu perlu mempersiapkan diri untuk menjalani beberapa tahapan seleksi yang cukup panjang. Perlu dicatat, tahapan berikut ini bukan informasi resmi dari PLN, melainkan rangkuman dari pengalaman peserta yang pernah mengikuti rekrutmen sebelumnya. Jadi, proses seleksi bisa berbeda tergantung tahun, lokasi, dan kebutuhan perusahaan. Namun, tahapan ini bisa jadi gambaran awal sekaligus bahan latihan dan persiapan. 1. Seleksi Administrasi Peserta diminta mengisi data diri lengkap di website resmi dan mengunggah dokumen seperti KTP, ijazah, transkrip nilai, akta kelahiran, KK, serta surat keterangan belum menikah atau buku nikah. Banyak yang bilang tahapan ini sudah menjadi seleksi awal, karena jika ada data tidak sesuai, sistem bisa langsung menggugurkan. Peserta disarankan menyiapkan data di satu file catatan agar mudah di-copy-paste. 2. Tes Kemampuan Dasar & General Aptitude Test (GAT) Tahap ini mirip dengan psikotes atau tes potensi akademik. Materi umumnya mencakup logika, penalaran, numerik, analitis, sinonim, antonim, hingga deret angka. Peserta juga diminta mengerjakan soal bahasa Inggris dasar. Baca juga: 100 Contoh Soal Tes Psikotes Kerja serta Jawaban & Pembahasannya 3. Tes Akademik dan Bahasa Inggris Pada tahap ini, peserta mengerjakan soal sesuai bidang studi atau jurusan, misalnya teknik elektro, mesin, sipil, akuntansi, atau hukum. Ada juga tes bahasa Inggris dengan standar minimal skor tertentu (misalnya setara TOEIC). 4. Tes Psikotes Lanjutan Tes ini berfokus pada kepribadian dan konsistensi. Bentuknya bisa berupa tes wartegg , menggambar pohon atau orang, hingga tes logika gambar. Tujuannya menilai kecerdasan emosional, pola pikir, serta kecocokan kandidat dengan budaya kerja PLN. 5. Tes Fisik dan Kesehatan Awal Pemeriksaan fisik dasar seperti tinggi dan berat badan, mata (minus, silinder, buta warna), pendengaran, hingga pemeriksaan dokter umum. Ada juga tes kebugaran sederhana. 6. Tes Kesehatan Lanjutan (Medical Check Up) Tes kesehatan di PLN dikenal cukup ketat. Pemeriksaan bisa mencakup EKG jantung, rontgen paru-paru, tes darah, tes urine, pemeriksaan organ dalam, hingga deteksi penyakit bawaan. Pada tahap ini, banyak peserta gugur karena hasil tes tidak sesuai standar kesehatan kerja. Jadi, pastikan kamu menjaga pola hidup sehat sejak jauh-jauh hari. Hindari rokok dan alkohol, serta perbanyak olahraga dan minum air putih. 7. Wawancara Sesi wawancara biasanya dilakukan oleh tim HR dan user. Pertanyaan seputar latar belakang pendidikan, pengalaman organisasi, motivasi, kesiapan ditempatkan di seluruh Indonesia, serta komitmen terhadap pekerjaan di BUMN energi. Baca juga: 30 Pertanyaan Tes Wawancara BUMN 2025 dan Contoh Jawabannya Syarat Umum Rekrutmen PLN 2025 Untuk bisa mengikuti Rekrutmen Nasional PLN 2025, peserta wajib memenuhi beberapa persyaratan dasar berikut: Warga Negara Indonesia, baik laki-laki maupun perempuan. Lulusan D3 dengan batas usia maksimal 25 tahun (kelahiran tahun 2000 dan sesudahnya) serta memiliki IPK minimal 3,0 . Lulusan S1/D4 dengan batas usia maksimal 27 tahun (kelahiran tahun 1998 dan sesudahnya) serta memiliki IPK minimal 3,0 . Peserta hanya diperbolehkan memilih satu bidang atau jurusan sesuai jenjang pendidikan dan program studi yang tercantum pada ijazah. Syarat Dokumen Selain syarat umum, peserta juga wajib mempersiapkan berkas-berkas yang dibutuhkan. Seluruh dokumen harus dipersiapkan dalam bentuk soft copy untuk diunggah ke website resmi rekrutmen PLN. Dokumen tersebut meliputi: KTP Ijazah Transkrip akademik Akta kelahiran Kartu Keluarga (KK) Surat keterangan belum menikah (bagi yang belum menikah) atau Buku Nikah/Akta Nikah (bagi yang sudah menikah) Cek syarat & cara pembuatan surat keterangan belum menikah untuk rekrutmen PLN di artikel berikut: Cara Membuat Surat Keterangan Belum Menikah untuk Rekrutmen PLN (+ Contohnya) Cara Mendaftar Rekrutmen PLN 2025 Pendaftaran rekrutmen nasional PLN Group dilakukan sepenuhnya secara daring. Berikut langkahnya: 1. Pergi ke Website Resmi Rekrutmen PLN Langkah pertama adalah membuka situs resmi rekrutmen di https://rekrutmen.pln.co.id/ . Di sisi kanan halaman utama, terdapat kotak login untuk member. Nah, di bagian inilah kamu bisa membuat akun baru. Masukkan nomor KTP atau alamat email, kemudian buat kata kunci sendiri dan isi kode verifikasi captcha yang muncul. Setelah itu, tekan tombol Daftar , dan sistem akan mengarahkanmu ke halaman pendaftaran akun. 2. Isi Data untuk Buat Akun Setelah menekan tombol daftar, akan muncul pop-up berisi form pembuatan akun. Pada tahap ini, kamu perlu melengkapi data diri seperti nama lengkap sesuai KTP, nomor KTP, alamat email, password , hingga data akademik berupa jenjang pendidikan, program studi, dan IPK terakhir. Jangan lupa masukkan kode captcha sebelum mengklik tombol Daftar . Begitu berhasil, sistem akan otomatis mengirimkan email konfirmasi ke alamat email yang sudah kamu daftarkan. Buka email tersebut, lalu klik tautan konfirmasi untuk mengaktifkan akunmu. 3. Login Menggunakan Akun yang Sudah Dibuat Setelah akun aktif, kembali ke halaman login di https://rekrutmen.pln.co.id/login . Masukkan nomor KTP atau email beserta password yang sudah kamu buat, lalu isi kode captcha. Jika data benar, kamu akan diarahkan masuk ke dashboard akun. Dari sini proses pendaftaran resmi dimulai. 4. Centang Persetujuan Pemrosesan Data Pribadi Begitu berhasil login, sistem akan menampilkan halaman persetujuan pemrosesan data pribadi. Kamu diminta membaca ketentuan mengenai bagaimana data akan digunakan oleh pihak PLN. Setelah membaca, centang kotak persetujuan di bagian bawah, lalu klik tombol Setuju . Setelah itu, akan muncul tampilan ucapan selamat datang yang menandakan akunmu sudah aktif sepenuhnya. Selanjutnya, klik tombol Mulai untuk melanjutkan ke tahap pengisian data. 5. Lengkapi CV Tahap berikutnya adalah melengkapi semua data CV yang diminta oleh sistem. Ada beberapa kategori data yang wajib diisi, mulai dari informasi pribadi, data keluarga, riwayat pendidikan, pengalaman kerja, organisasi, hingga prestasi dan sertifikasi. Semakin lengkap data yang kamu masukkan, semakin besar peluang untuk lolos seleksi administrasi. Usahakan jangan ada kolom yang kosong agar sistem tidak menandai datamu sebagai belum lengkap. 6. Lamar Lowongan yang Tersedia Setelah seluruh data diri terisi, kamu bisa langsung menuju laman detail lowongan kerja sesuai yang kamu minati: PT PLN Indonesia Power : https://rekrutmen.pln.co.id/vacancy/site/view/id/MjE5MzgxNzU4NTMzOTE2 PT PLN Electricity Services : https://rekrutmen.pln.co.id/vacancy/site/view/id/MjE5NDQxNzU4NTM2MDcw PT PLN Nusantara Power : https://rekrutmen.pln.co.id/vacancy/site/view/id/MjE5NTIxNzU5MTUwMDMz PLN GROUP untuk Lulusan Hukum : https://rekrutmen.pln.co.id/vacancy/site/view/id/MjE5NjAxNzU5MjUxMTM5 PT PLN Energi Primer Indonesia: https://rekrutmen.pln.co.id/vacancy/site/view/id/MTE5NDExNzU4NTM1ODEz PLN GROUP untuk Bidang Matematika: https://rekrutmen.pln.co.id/vacancy/site/view/id/MjE5NTQxNzU5MTUxMDM2 PT PLN Nusa Daya : https://rekrutmen.pln.co.id/vacancy/site/view/id/MjE5NDIxNzU4NTM1ODY5 Setelah menekan tombol 'lamar' , lamaranmu akan tercatat di sistem, dan kamu tinggal menunggu tahapan seleksi berikutnya. Baca juga: Gaji BUMN 2025 di PLN, Pertamina, Telkom, KAI, Wika, & 5 Lainnya Info Lowongan Kerja Lainnya Rekrutmen PLN memang jadi salah satu jalur populer buat kamu yang ingin berkarier di BUMN energi. Tapi kalau kamu juga ingin memperluas opsi ke industri lain, ada banyak peluang karier menarik yang bisa kamu temukan di Dealls. Lewat Dealls, kamu bisa menjelajahi ribuan lowongan kerja dari beragam industri, mulai dari perbankan, teknologi, manufaktur, kesehatan, hingga startup digital. Posisi yang tersedia juga sangat beragam, seperti Management Trainee, Digital Marketing, Data Analyst, HR, hingga Software Engineer. Selain itu, Dealls punya fitur filter gaji dan lokasi yang memudahkan kamu menyesuaikan pencarian sesuai kebutuhan dan target karier. Jadi, kalau kamu masih eksplorasi jalur karier di luar PLN, langsung saja buka Dealls, gunakan filter pencarian, dan temukan lowongan yang paling cocok dengan profilmu.

title: MySQL Mocking with Speedscale's Proxymock: A Complete Guide
summary: Record real MySQL traffic with proxymock and replay it in tests. Eliminate local database setup and flaky CI runs.
body_text: Introduction Testing database-driven applications is notoriously painful. If your app depends on MySQL, you’ve probably spent hours setting up local databases, running migrations, loading data, and then cleaning everything up just to rerun your tests. This repetitive cycle slows development, breaks pipelines, and introduces inconsistency between local and production environments. Matt explains this perfectly in this video : when your testing process depends on a live database, you’re constantly fighting setup issues rather than building features. Every developer wants accurate tests, but not at the cost of productivity. This is where Speedscale’s proxymock comes in. Proxymock allows you to record and mock MySQL traffic, enabling your application to behave as if it’s connected to a real database without requiring one to be running. This blog will guide you through what MySQL mocking is, its benefits, and how to implement it step-by-step using proxymock. What is MySQL and Why Mock It? MySQL is one of the world’s most popular open-source relational database management systems (RDBMS). It powers countless applications, from small web apps to enterprise-grade systems. But when it comes to local development and CI/CD testing, running a full MySQL instance can be unnecessary or inefficient. Mocking solves this problem by allowing you to: Simulate database responses without an actual running database. Reproduce production scenarios consistently for debugging. Speed up local testing by removing database setup time. Run CI pipelines faster without containerized or external MySQL dependencies. Avoid waiting for data refreshes or shared environment resets. Work with your own isolated database instance without stepping on other developers’ data. Proxymock makes this easy by recording real MySQL traffic and then replaying it in subsequent tests. Typical Solution The traditional approach is to replicate production as closely as possible. You make a copy of your database, clean the data, spin up MySQL locally, and load the copy into it. Then you point your application at this database and start testing. That works… until you realize you have to do it again every time your schema or data changes. Each test run becomes a mini DevOps project. It looks something like this: This approach is functional but inefficient. Resetting the database, reloading data, or reproducing complex transactions across multiple tables takes time. On large teams, that delay compounds fast. Every engineer ends up babysitting their test data instead of building or debugging code. Our Solution: Service Mocking At Speedscale, we built proxymock to make service mocking effortless. Instead of running a real database, you can record and replay actual MySQL interactions. proxymock captures the communication between your app and a live MySQL service once, then simulates that same behavior later — just like the real thing, but faster and isolated. It’s like having a local clone of your database that always responds the same way, without sharing infrastructure or wrestling with seeded data. Key benefits include: Realistic behavior : all queries and responses match real-world traffic. Repeatable results : your tests are consistent across runs and machines. Instant startup : no waiting for MySQL to boot or data to load. Simplicity : setup takes minutes, not hours. How It Works Here’s what the workflow looks like in practice. Recording MySQL Traffic with Proxymock When debugging or testing database-dependent services, being able to replay real MySQL interactions can save hours of setup and guesswork. Proxymock makes this possible by recording live database traffic into Request/Response Pair (RRPair) files. Start the Recorder In a dedicated terminal, run: proxymock record --map 13306=localhost:3306 --app-port 8080 This command tells Proxymock to: Listen on port 13306 Forward all traffic to the real MySQL server at 3306 Capture each request and response as an RRPair You can learn more about how this works in the proxymock docs . Configure Your MySQL Connection In a separate terminal, configure your application to route traffic through the proxy: export MYSQL_HOST = localhost export MYSQL_PORT = 13306 export MYSQL_DATABASE = auth_db java -jar target/auth-1.1.7.jar Normally, apps connect directly to localhost:3306. By switching to 13306, you route all database queries through Proxymock, enabling it to record them. If you’re using the demo app, make sure MySQL is running and the demo database exists (see the demo README). What Gets Recorded After interacting with your app, inspect the captured data: proxymock inspect Each RRPair file includes: Request data: SQL queries, prepared statements, and connection handshakes Response data: Result sets, errors, and metadata Timing info: Query execution times and latency Although MySQL uses a binary protocol, Proxymock converts it into readable JSON . You can even edit these files to simulate different responses or test edge cases. Starting the Mock Server Before running the mock server, stop your local MySQL instance to prevent port conflicts. You can now run your app against the standard MySQL port (3306) — Proxymock will act as your simulated database. Start the mock server with: proxymock mock Your MySQL client or app will now connect to Proxymock on port 3306 just like a real database. Modifying Responses You can manually edit the RRPair files (Markdown or JSON) to change returned values, inject errors, or tweak timing. To automate transformations, use Speedscale Enterprise transforms : proxymock cloud push snapshot This uploads your snapshot to the Speedscale Cloud. A link will be provided — open it in the UI to add transforms such as: Randomized IDs or timestamps Latency injection Error simulation Click Save , then download the modified snapshot: proxymock cloud pull snapshot < i d > You’ll see a new .metadata directory containing your transform definitions. Next time you run: proxymock mock Those transforms will automatically apply to your mock. Proxymock gives you a full loop — record, inspect, and replay — for realistic database simulation. Perfect for testing, troubleshooting, or CI/CD environments without needing a live database. Value of Proxymock The ROI of mocking MySQL with proxymock is immediate and measurable. Let’s do some quick math: Setting up and reloading a local MySQL database typically takes about 1 hour per developer per day (between migrations, data loads, and cleanup). Using proxymock , you can record once and replay indefinitely. Setup time drops to under 5 minutes. If you have a 10-person dev team: Traditional setup: 10 hours/day spent on database maintenance. With proxymock : <1 hour/day total. That’s 45+ hours saved per week, or nearly two full work weeks per month reclaimed for actual development. And the best part? You get repeatable, production-accurate test environments that don’t require babysitting. For CI/CD pipelines, the savings are even more dramatic. You can remove MySQL service dependencies entirely, reducing build times and cloud costs while improving reliability. Troubleshooting Recording Issues If you encounter problems while recording traffic, check the following: Ensure your MySQL driver supports SOCKS5 proxy or use reverse proxy mapping. Verify the tcp_proxy environment variable is set correctly. Make sure your MySQL server is actually accessible by proxymock., proxymock cloud push snapshotproxymock cloud pull snapshot < i d > When to Use MySQL Mocking MySQL mocking is especially valuable for: CI/CD pipelines where you want deterministic test results. Load testing without setting up massive amounts of test data. Feature development when backend teams are still building the actual database schema. Resilience testing to ensure your app handles database downtime gracefully. Conclusion Proxymock makes it simple to replace a real MySQL database with a lightweight, simulated environment. By recording real interactions and replaying them later, you can dramatically simplify local development and testing. With this setup, you’ll be able to: Record MySQL traffic once. Run your app in mock mode without a real database. Customize responses for advanced testing scenarios. This approach not only saves time but also ensures consistency and reliability across your dev and CI environments. Next Steps If you’re tired of database setup slowing down your testing workflow, it’s time to give proxymock a try. Watch Matt’s video - he walks through the core pain points and why mocking is a game-changer. Read the MySQL Docs - for detailed instructions, architecture visuals, and advanced examples. Download Proxymock - and start mocking your MySQL traffic in minutes. Simplify your stack. Speed up your tests. Get back to building.

title: Introducing Chatwoot Affiliates
summary: Introducing Chatwoot Affiliates, a partner program for people who recommend open-source customer support software to growing teams.
body_text: Over the past few months, we’ve noticed something interesting, many of our paid customers have been bringing in new users. They’ve been telling their peers, communities, and clients about Chatwoot. We’ve never had an affiliate program before, but it felt like the right time to change that. Today, we’re launching the Chatwoot Affiliate Program — a simple way to reward the people who already believe in us. How it works It’s simple: Sign up at cloud-partners.chatwoot.com . Create your coupon code — it’s yours to share. Invite your network to start using Chatwoot Cloud. When someone upgrade with your code: They’ll get 5% off their Chatwoot Cloud subscription. You’ll earn 20% of the revenue they bring in for the first 12 months. Why are we doing this We’ve always believed in community-driven growth. Most of our milestones — from GitHub stars to customers — have come through word of mouth. Lately, we’ve seen more teams joining because a customer or partner recommended us. This program is just a way of saying thank you to those who help us grow. Who can join Anyone who believes in Chatwoot — creators, consultants, agencies, developers, or customers. If you’re already using Chatwoot and love it, this is an easy way to give others a push to get started — and earn along the way. Start now Join here: cloud-partners.chatwoot.com Let’s grow together.
